A new schedule opened by edit and closed by abort accepted quoted day names and quoted times and normalized 8:5 to 08:05. Live through Admin on the same FortiGate-60F on 2026-11-23 (preview, apply with the approved plan hash, readback by the check account in its own held session, undo): create with two weekdays and times, an end update and its undo, the undo of the create; a schedule used by a firewall policy was refused for delete (fortios_object_referenced); apply without the plan hash was refused. show and show full-configuration of the table had the same sha256 before and after the run. On FortiOS 8.0.2 build0251 the preview was refused with safeguard_no_rest_inverse.
